Pros:
Beautiful graphics and world design
Main story, side quests, and overall world-building are solid
PvP is available (a plus for those who enjoy it)

Cons:
Heavy pay-to-win elements, especially after the main story / at endgame
Strong “mobile cash grab” feel in progression systems
PvP can be a negative for players who don’t enjoy it

Verdict:
Worth playing for the story and early experience, but not recommended for long-term endgame investment unless you’re fine with the monetization and PvP focus.

Despite the deluge of negativity around the P2W system, which having only played PVE, I haven't seen yet, this game is a lot of fun with a rewarding progression system for the early part of the game. The classless system is engaging because you can truly build out a character however you want and it gives more incentive to grind out various weapon skills and create a character that can handle any situation. 

The visuals are quite good for an MMO, with great optimization for anyone running a decently good rig. DLSS of course helps, but that doesn't stop the game from running smoothly, with little lag or server issues either. The art design is a feast as well. The various creatures, bosses, world events and enviroments all look amazing from a design perspective. It is a good blend of western and eastern sensibilites. 

The community has been positive so far, before the launch of the F2P model. Here's to hoping that it stays that way for the duration of the title. 

For anyone that is still reading, do not be discouraged by all of the negativity. The gaming community, especially for MMO's always seems to be increasingly toxic, wanting to compare everything to a game that they played 10 years ago, instead of assuming positive intent and embracing change and new ways of interweaving old mechanics with new.

Great Game, But No Cross Progression in 2024 - 2025? Seriously?

I had an amazing time playing Throne and Liberty on PS5, the gameplay, world, and overall experience were fantastic. However, when I tried to play on PC, I was shocked to find out that there’s no cross progression.

It’s 2025, and games especially MMOs, should have cross progression by default. I get it for competitive eSports titles, but for a game like this, it just feels outdated and frustrating. I don’t want to restart from scratch after investing time and progress on another platform.

Because of this, I simply won’t play anymore. It’s disappointing, because Throne and Liberty has so much potential, but I can’t justify starting over when cross progression should be a standard feature. Hope they reconsider this in the future.

Sadly if you try to spend any significant amount of time the cracks start to show, and they are large.
- Overworld enemies drop little to no items, seemingly to counter botting.
- The community wants to run dungeons quickly as its one of the very few ways to get items you need, this leads to a miserable experience if you're trying to learn dungeons in public groups
- This game is OBSESSED with lockouts. If you don't like dailies/weeklies, you will hate this game's endgame loop
- The schedule is exhausting, this game wants you logged in 24/7 or setting a timer to get back on at least once every other hour for one event or another. From world bosses to casual events everything is on a set schedule and it gets TIRING.

There is more, P2W elements, lack of real PvE endgame, recycled content, PvP balance issues, etc. etc. but really it just comes down to the simple fact of the more you engage with this game the more exhausting it becomes.
